title: 第472章 一个一个来
slug: 穿越源卡大陆我自带融合卡牌
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“洛恩！洛恩你怎么了？！”

米娅走出房门，一眼就看到浑身被烧得焦黑的洛恩。

此时洛恩狼狈瘫坐在地，皮肉烧得狰狞，整个人目光空洞涣散，嘴里不停呢喃着什么。

米娅吓得快步冲下楼，扑到儿子身前。

她扭头看上一旁的几个小妾，着急问道：“这是怎么回事，洛恩怎么了？”

怎么了？疯了呗。

几个小妾面面相觑，不知道该怎么说。

最终还是其中一个比较机灵的，轻声回道。

“夫人，洛恩好像是被吓着了。”

被吓着了？

米娅一脸疑惑。

这里只有她们几个侍妾，谁吓他了？

不等米娅追问，林奇淡漠的声音响起，打断了她的思绪。

他目光扫过一众侍妾，随意抬手一指。

“你！上楼。”

说话间，那侍妾身上的藤蔓妖松开，解开了她的束缚。

“我，我……”

那名侍妾浑身一颤，手足无措。

她慌乱转头看向米娅，想要寻求帮助。

可米娅此时心里都是洛恩，哪有时间管她。

那侍妾又环顾一下周围的姐妹。

其他人皆是小声劝道：

“快去吧，好好服侍他，我们就能活下去了。”

那侍妾一咬嘴唇，强忍着恐惧，爬起身来忐忑的向着二楼走去。

…………

几分钟后。

二楼紧闭的房门

那侍妾步履虚浮的走了下来，颤声道：

“该……该下一个人了……”

众人还没明白什么意思，又有一个侍妾身上的藤蔓妖脱落。

第二名侍妾惊疑不定地看向前者，见她轻轻点头，只能咬牙壮胆，踏上二楼。

又过了3分钟，

房门再次

“该轮到下一个了。”

同样的话语响起，

剩下几个还被绑着的藤蔓妖侍妾，皆是一脸懵逼。

她们此时心里只有一个念头。

“这个黑袍男人精力这么旺盛的吗？”

“不过，这时间会不会太短了呀？”

依旧是藤蔓妖脱落，又一个侍妾上楼，然后再下楼。

直到所有人都上去过二楼，林奇这才满意的和最后一个侍妾走了下来。

“这群贵族太太，真是有钱。”

他把这些人挨个叫上楼恐吓，果然得到了不少源晶。

米娅是正妻，手握府邸公产，资源虽多，但花销的也多，整个府邸都要她管理。

Page (1/3)

"Lorne! Lorn what's wrong with you?!"

Mia walked out of the room and saw Lorne who was completely burnt.

At this time, Lorne was sitting on the ground in a state of embarrassment, his skin and flesh burned horribly, his eyes were empty and distracted, and he kept mumbling something.

Mia was so frightened that she quickly rushed downstairs and threw herself in front of her son.

She turned to look at the concubines beside her and asked anxiously: "What's going on? What's wrong with Lorne?"

What's wrong?Crazy.

Several concubines looked at each other, not knowing what to say.

In the end, one of the smarter ones replied softly.

"Ma'am, Lorne seems to be frightened."

Scared?

Mia looked confused.

There were only a few concubines like them here, who scared him?

Before Mia could ask further questions, Lynch's indifferent voice sounded, interrupting her thoughts.

He glanced at the concubines and raised his hand casually.

"You! Go upstairs."

As he spoke, the vine demon on the concubine loosened its bonds and untied her.

"I, I..."

The concubine trembled all over and was at a loss.

She panicked and turned to look at Mia, wanting to ask for help.

But Mia was thinking about Lorne at the moment, so she had no time to care about her.

The concubine looked around at the sisters again.

Everyone else whispered:

"Go quickly and serve him well, and we will survive."

The concubine bit her lip, suppressed her fear, got up and walked towards the second floor anxiously.

…………

After a few minutes.

Closed door on the second floor

The concubine walked down with frivolous steps and said in a trembling voice:

"It's...it's time for the next person..."

Before everyone could understand what it meant, another concubine had her vine demon falling off.

The second concubine looked at the former in surprise, and when she saw her gently nodding, she could only grit her teeth and bravely step onto the second floor.

Another 3 minutes passed,

door again

"It's the next one's turn."

The same words sounded,

The few remaining vine demon concubines who were still tied up looked confused.

They had only one thought in their minds at this time.

"Is this man in black robe so energetic?"

"But, isn't this time too short?"

The vine demon still fell off, and another concubine went upstairs, and then went downstairs.

It wasn't until everyone had gone up to the second floor that Lin Qi was satisfied and walked down with the last concubine.

"These noble ladies are really rich."

He called these people upstairs one by one to threaten them, and as expected he got a lot of source crystals.

Mia is the head wife and holds the public property of the mansion. Although there are many resources, there are also many expenses. She has to manage the entire mansion.
